mundane_explanation.surviving: doc-vs-implementation divergence on the 400 face: the versioned documentation (per the contract's build-time verified quote) pins '400 for an invalid group_by' with the precondition 'grouping requires payload values for the group_by field', while the v1.18.0 default implementation path resolves a zero-values group_by to a silent 200 empty-groups success (must_not-IsEmpty exclusion + empty-break). Per-point exclusion is explicitly by-design in source; the no-values-anywhere -> 200 disposition carries no explicit intent marker in source (no comment/test), so the divergence survives as a genuine defect signal for the adjudicator, who must weigh the interpretive bridge between 'requires payload values' and 'invalid group_by'.
